text:
alyssa: Quick thread  planning for the LangChain + LlamaIndex marketplace demo next week. Need: standardized sandbox creds, marketplace listing checklist, and a short failover/runbook.

kevin: I can draft the marketplace checklist (assets, screenshots, billing notes). Do we have a canonical creds format for partners?

dina: We should issue per-partner scoped tokens via temp-creds service. Short TTL (48h) + scoped to embeddings/generate. Prefer JWTs with exp and scope claims.

kevin: ok adding token spec to the checklist. Also include a marketplace section for pricing tiers and trial credits.

tom: Ops note  put demo requests behind a sandbox project with capped quota (50k tokens) and billing disabled. Snapshot the demo dataset and pin model version.

alyssa: Legal wants an asset attestation PDF before we hand keys out. Also security wants IP allowlist or VPN access for partner engineers.

dina: We can attach IP allowlist and require the partner to use our demo SDK header x-rwd-demo to help signal traffic.

integrations-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-5077: "Marketplace demo prep - LangChain/LlamaIndex" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-5077

kevin: I'll populate the drive folder with the checklist + sample listing copy: https://drive.redwood.com/partners/langchain-marketplace-demo

tom: I'll upload dataset snapshot to s3://redwood-partner-demos/langchain/v1 and add a small prompt pack for regression checks.

alyssa: Action items: kevin checklist + listing copy, dina token+rotation script, tom dataset+quota, alyssa legal attestation. Target: drafts by EOD and dry-run Tue.

dina: rotation script PR by 6pm local.

kevin: checklist share by 5pm.

tom: snapshot uploaded by 4pm.

alyssa: thanks team  will update PARTNER-5077 with these notes and schedule dry-run invite. :calendar:
